$comment: Rationale manifest for every check recorded as UNKNOWN (never auto-PASS). Two flavors: gap_documented = behavior demonstrated and recorded, but the written protocol does not require the stronger property (or the enforcing layer is undelivered); blocked = cannot be executed because the enforcing component was not delivered in the S0 snapshot. freeze_blocking=true marks UNKNOWNs the Commander has ruled must be dispositioned before G1 Freeze (not deferrable).

PKG-ENTRY-01.rationale: Live package barrel/@intent/protocol-schema entry import was not evaluated against the frozen snapshot: Builder A edited the live tree twice during verification (missing events.js -> fixed; Milestone/Plan/Run/Grant/Edge/Dispute objects removed; artifact content_hash renamed payload_hash; SubjectRef charset widened). Re-run scripts/capture-sut.mjs to pin a newer SUT.

C-07-01.rationale: No uniqueness constraint on criterion_id: two same-id criteria with different assertions are both schema-valid and mutually ambiguous for any verifier resolving criteria by id.
C-07-01.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: must criterion_id be unique within success_criteria?

C-07-02.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: must constraint_id be unique within constraints?

C-07-04.rationale: Duplicate artifact hashes/run ids accepted while a bundle is OPEN; the delivered superRefine only guards SEALED.

C-07-07.rationale: Duplicate keys in raw JSON text collapse last-wins at JS parse time before canonicalization; two byte-different evidence texts can share one hash.

C-08-05.rationale: Criterion.threshold is open-ended JSON by design; arbitrary nested semantics are representable inside a frozen criterion.

C-08-06.rationale: Unknown-field strictness for Milestone/Plan/ExecutionRun/CapabilityGrant/ContributionEdge/DisputeCase cannot be tested: objects documented in arch doc §6 are absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-09-08.rationale: EvidenceArtifact carries no self content_hash field; a received artifact cannot prove its own metadata integrity the way a sealed Intent can (payload_hash covers CAS bytes only).

C-09-09.rationale: payload_hash is format-checked only; the (bytes, hash) binding is enforced by CAS-side recomputation outside the delivered layer.

C-10-08.rationale: Milestone acceptance-criteria immutability cannot be tested: Milestone object absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-11-05.rationale: Economic invariant total_amount == sum(outputs.amount) is not enforced anywhere in the delivered layer.
C-11-05.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: which layer owns the total_amount == sum(outputs.amount) invariant (schema, policy, or settlement engine)?

C-11-06.rationale: No canonical decimal form: '-0', '0.00', '1.10' are all accepted; the same economic value has multiple hashes across implementations.
C-11-06.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: what IS the canonical decimal form (and how are '-0'/'0.00'/'1.10' normalized)?

C-12-06.rationale: A decision may reference an OPEN (unsealed) bundle; nothing in the delivered layer binds decision validity to bundle state.

C-12-07.rationale: Same bundle_id with a different artifact set is representable; no uniqueness/append-only constraint exists in the schema layer.

C-13-02c.rationale: SubjectRef id charset was widened to include '@' during verification; lookalike principal ids (alice@evil) are now valid. Commander ruling OQ-5 (2026-09-17): SubjectRef V1 is accepted as a shape but '@' must be REMOVED; once Builder A lands it, this check must flip to assert rejection.

C-13-09b.rationale: UUID schema accepts any RFC version and uppercase; intent ids are not pinned to a single version/canonical form.

C-13-12.rationale: Run manifest / grant / edge NodeRef / dispute reference validation cannot be tested: objects absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-14-02.rationale: decision.intent_hash can be fabricated; no delivered API binds a decision to an existing Intent object.
C-14-02.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: which layer owns Decision/Settlement cross-object binding (schema-time, verification-engine, or ledger)?

C-14-03.rationale: decision.evidence_root need not equal merkleRoot(bundle.artifact_hashes); the contradiction is representable.
C-14-03.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: which layer owns Decision/Settlement cross-object binding (schema-time, verification-engine, or ledger)?

C-14-04.rationale: Settlement may reference a dangling decision_id and arbitrary proof_binding.
C-14-04.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: which layer owns Decision/Settlement cross-object binding (schema-time, verification-engine, or ledger)?

C-14-05.rationale: decision.milestone_id / bundle.milestone_id can dangle; no Milestone object is delivered at all.

C-14-08.rationale: verification/settlement policy refs are content-addressed but no policy object schema ships to bind them.

C-14-09.rationale: ContributionEdge.evidence_ref existence unenforceable: Edge object absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-14-10.rationale: DisputeCase.challenged_decision existence unenforceable: DisputeCase object absent.

C-14-11.rationale: ExecutionRun.grants existence/scope unenforceable: Run/Grant objects absent.

C-15-04.rationale: A SEALED bundle may declare a merkle_root that does not match its artifact_hashes; only external recomputation detects the lie.
C-15-04.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-17 (Issue #1 disposition): must be decided before G1 Freeze; cannot be deferred to a later layer. Question: must a SEALED bundle's merkle_root be verified against artifact_hashes at seal time?

C-15-05.rationale: Delivered EvidenceBundleState has 2 of the 7 states documented in arch doc §7; VERIFYING/VALID/INVALID/INSUFFICIENT/CHALLENGED are absent.

C-15-06.rationale: Milestone state machine (arch doc §7) not delivered.

C-15-07.rationale: Settlement state machine (arch doc §7) not delivered; SettlementInstruction has no state field in S0.

C-15-08.rationale: Intent state machine (arch doc §7) not delivered.

C-15-09.rationale: G0 gate 'illegal transitions 100% blocked' cannot be evaluated: no state-machine code exists (@intent/intent-core absent).

C-12-08.rationale: proof_binding is computed over (intent_hash, milestone_revision, evidence_root, policy_hash) ONLY; the binding function does not accept milestone_id. Two different milestones sharing those four values therefore share ONE proof binding: an old proof is replayable across proof targets. Demonstrated as a machine-reproducible collision by C-12-08.
C-12-08.commander_ruling: Commander ruling R9 (PROOF TARGET BINDING), 2026-09-17: V1 proof_binding MUST bind at least intent_hash + milestone_id + milestone_revision + evidence_root + policy_hash. A proof must prove the result belongs to THIS specific milestone. Not deferrable to S1.
